content.text:
aliases:
          - sendinblue-api.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  localstack:
    image: gresau/localstack-persist:4
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:4566/_localstack/health"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
    environment:
      - SERVICES=s3
      - EXTRA_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${LOCALSTACK_CORS_ORIGINS}
    volumes:
      - ./localstack:/etc/localstack/init/ready.d
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - localstack.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  imgproxy:
    image: darthsim/imgproxy:latest
    environment:
      - IMGPROXY_KEY=e4b9d1f5a2c3e6f7d8b0a9c1e3d5f7a2
      - IMGPROXY_SALT=1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d
      - IMGPROXY_SIGNATURE_SIZE=32
      - IMGPROXY_USE_S3=true
      # Bare compose service name, not the public/internal alias: this is a same-network
      # container-to-container call, exactly like spring-app's SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL below.
      - IMGPROXY_S3_ENDPOINT=http://localstack:4566
      - IMGPROXY_S3_REGION=eu-central-1
      - IMGPROXY_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=true
      - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=YOUR_ACCESS_KEY
      - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=YOUR_SECRET_KEY
      - IMGPROXY_ENABLE_DEBUG_HEADERS=true
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - imgproxy.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  spring-app:
    build:
      context: ../.
      dockerfile: docker/spring/Dockerfile
      secrets:
        - github_token
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; echo -e 'GET /health HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' >&3"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s
    depends_on:
      urbo-backend-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy
      localstack:
        condition: service_healthy
      sendinblue-api:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint: ["java", "-Dspring.profiles.active=local", "-jar", "/app.jar"]
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - spring-app.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}
    environment:
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: postgres
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: postgres
      SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_ISSUER_URI: ${SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_ISSUER_URI}
      SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_JWK_SET_URI: ${SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_JWK_SET_URI}
      KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_URL: ${KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_URL}
      APP_CORS_URLS: ${APP_CORS_URLS}
      AWS_S3_ENDPOINT: ${AWS_S3_ENDPOINT}
      AWS_S3_FORCEPATHSTYLE: "true"
      SWCODE_MEILISEARCH_URL: ${SWCODE_MEILISEARCH_URL}
      IMGPROXY_URL: ${IMGPROXY_URL}
      URBO_NOTIFICATION_SENDINBLUE_APIURL: ${URBO_NOTIFICATION_SENDINBLUE_APIURL}
      URBO_SURVEY_LIMESURVEY_BASE_URL: ${URBO_SURVEY_LIMESURVEY_BASE_URL}
      URBO_CMS_ACCESSIBILITY_SUBMISSIONS_URL: ${URBO_CMS_ACCESSIBILITY_SUBMISSIONS_URL}
      URBO_CMS_PARTICIPATION_STATEMENTS_URL: ${URBO_CMS_PARTICIPATION_STATEMENTS_URL}

  # Runs psql against the stack's existing Postgres and exits. Overriding the entrypoint keeps the
  # image's own docker-entrypoint.sh out of it, so this never starts a second Postgres server.
  limesurvey-db-init:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    profiles: ["limesurvey"]
    depends_on:
      urbo-backend-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./limesurvey/create-limesurvey-database.sh:/create-limesurvey-database.sh:ro
    entrypoint: [ "/bin/sh", "/create-limesurvey-database.sh" ]
    environment:
      PGHOST: urbo-backend-postgres
      PGPORT: "5432"
      PGDATABASE: postgres
      PGUSER: postgres
      PGPASSWORD: postgres
      LIMESURVEY_DB_NAME: limesurvey
    restart: "no"
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  limesurvey:
    image: martialblog/limesurvey:6-apache
    profiles: ["limesurvey"]
    depends_on:
      limesurvey-db-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    volumes:
      # A named volume, not a bind mount: Docker seeds it from the image, so LimeSurvey finds the
      # themes and generated files it ships with. A bind mount would start out empty and break it.
      - urbo-limesurvey-uploads:/var/www/html/upload
      - ./limesurvey/enable-remote-control.php:/enable-remote-control.php:ro
      - ./limesurvey/import-sample-surveys.sh:/import-sample-surveys.sh:ro
      - ./limesurvey/sample-surveys:/sample-surveys:ro
    # The image entrypoint still runs first and provisions the schema; this only replaces its
    # `apache2-foreground` command, so the API is switched on and the sample surveys are imported
    # before the site serves its first request. Separated by `;` rather than `&&` on purpose: a
    # seeding problem is a nuisance, not a reason to leave the developer without LimeSurvey at all,
    # and each script reports its own errors.
    command: [ "sh", "-c", "php /enable-remote-control.php; sh /import-sample-surveys.sh; exec apache2-foreground" ]
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: pgsql
      DB_HOST: urbo-backend-postgres
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_NAME: limesurvey
      # The image defaults to this, but only as a shell variable its entrypoint never exports.
      # enable-remote-control.php needs to see the same prefix, so it is set explicitly here.
      DB_TABLE_PREFIX: lime_
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD: postgres
      ADMIN_USER: admin
      ADMIN_NAME: Urbo Admin
      ADMIN_EMAIL: test@test.de
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      PUBLIC_URL: ${LIMESURVEY_PUBLIC_URL}
      # No ENCRYPT_* keys on purpose. LimeSurvey then generates a throwaway security.php per
      # container, which is fine for dev: recreating the container makes previously encrypted
      # participant data unreadable, and nothing here is worth keeping.
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - limesurvey.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  sample-images:
    image: nginx:alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - ./sample-data/images:/usr/share/nginx/sample-images:ro
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - sample-images.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  sample-data-loader:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    profiles: ["seed"]
    depends_on:
      spring-app:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./sample-data:/sample-data:ro
    command: [ "python", "/sample-data/seed-sample-data.py" ]
    environment:
      SAMPLE_DATA_ENABLED: "true"
      SAMPLE_DATA_BACKEND_HEALTH_URL: ${SAMPLE_DATA_BACKEND_HEALTH_URL}
      SAMPLE_DATA_BACKEND_BASE_URL: ${SAMPLE_DATA_BACKEND_BASE_URL}
      SAMPLE_DATA_TOKEN_URL: ${SAMPLE_DATA_TOKEN_URL}
      SAMPLE_DATA_IMAGE_BASE_URL: ${SAMPLE_DATA_IMAGE_BASE_URL}
      SAMPLE_DATA_CLIENT_ID: ${SAMPLE_DATA_CLIENT_ID:-urbo-integration}
      SAMPLE_DATA_CLIENT_SECRET: ${SAMPLE_DATA_CLIENT_SECRET:-test}
      SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID: ${SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID:-urbo-frontend}
      SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_USERNAME: ${SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_USERNAME:-test@test.de}
      SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SAMPLE_DATA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-test}
      SAMPLE_DATA_DIRECTORY: /sample-data
      SAMPLE_DATA_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: ${SAMPLE_DATA_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-900}
      SAMPLE_DATA_WAIT_INTERVAL_SECONDS: ${SAMPLE_DATA_WAIT_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-5}
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    restart: "no"
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

volumes:
  urbo-cms-data:
  urbo-limesurvey-uploads:

secrets:
  # Read straight from the developer's environment; never written to disk and never
  # baked into an image layer. `just doctor` checks it is set before the build starts.
  github_token:
    environment: GITHUB_TOKEN
